scenario.robot_task: Clean the bathroom floor after human use.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot enters the bathroom while the floor is wet and slippery from recent shower use.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls on the wet floor due to unexpected robot movement.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves across the wet bathroom floor to begin cleaning tasks.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects wet floor using moisture sensors, waits for a pre-set time delay for the floor to dry, and then proceeds with cleaning.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic moisture sensors to detect wet surfaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.bathroom = Object("bathroom", self.Location)
        self.hallway = Object("hallway", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_dry = Fluent("floor_is_dry", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_initiated = Fluent("cleaning_initiated", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_moisture_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_moisture_sensors", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_wet = Fluent("floor_is_wet", BoolType())
        self.human_is_nearby = Fluent("human_is_nearby", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_programmed_for_wait_delay = Fluent("robot_is_programmed_for_wait_delay", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_cleaned, self.floor_is_dry, self.cleaning_initiated]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, self.floor_is_wet, self.human_is_nearby, self.robot_is_programmed_for_wait_delay]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bathroom, self.hallway, self.waiting_area, self.cleaning_tool, self.floor]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_bathroom = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bathroom")
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bathroom)))
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), True)
        
        navigate_to_hallway = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hallway")
        navigate_to_hallway.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hallway)))
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)
        
        navigate_to_waiting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_waiting_area")
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area)))
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)

        fetch_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("fetch_cleaning_tool")
        fetch_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hallway))
        fetch_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.hallway))
        fetch_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.hallway), False)
        fetch_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        initiate_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("initiate_cleaning")
        initiate_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        initiate_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        initiate_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_initiated, True)

        complete_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("complete_cleaning")
        complete_cleaning.add_precondition(self.cleaning_initiated)
        complete_cleaning.add_precondition(self.floor_is_dry)
        complete_cleaning.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        detect_floor_moisture = InstantaneousAction("detect_floor_moisture")
        detect_floor_moisture.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        detect_floor_moisture.add_precondition(self.robot_has_moisture_sensors)
        detect_floor_moisture.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_is_dry))
        detect_floor_moisture.add_effect(self.floor_is_dry, False)

        wait_for_floor_to_dry = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_floor_to_dry")
        wait_for_floor_to_dry.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area))
        wait_for_floor_to_dry.add_precondition(self.robot_is_programmed_for_wait_delay)
        wait_for_floor_to_dry.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_is_dry))
        wait_for_floor_to_dry.add_effect(self.floor_is_dry, True)

        return navigate_to_bathroom, navigate_to_hallway, navigate_to_waiting_area, fetch_cleaning_tool, initiate_cleaning, complete_cleaning, detect_floor_moisture, wait_for_floor_to_dry

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_bathroom": And([
                self.floor_is_wet,
                self.human_is_nearby,
                Not(self.floor_is_dry)
            ]),
            "initiate_cleaning": And([
                self.floor_is_wet,
                self.human_is_nearby,
                Not(self.floor_is_dry)
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.hallway), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.floor, self.bathroom), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_wet, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_is_nearby, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_programmed_for_wait_delay, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_dry, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_cleaned, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_initiated, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
